purpose: Define the smallest joined evidence packets that can validate or reject the three existing leading deployment decisions and conditional stronger claims.
authority: Research specification only. No outreach, procurement, private-data request, experiment, commercial action or new access is initiated.
source_policy: Accepted repository evidence only; no new retrieval, denial retry or synthetic calibration.
threshold_policy: The operator must set service, safety/quality, time and decision-relevant uncertainty limits before evaluating outcomes. No universal sample size, confidence level, success percentage or ROI threshold is invented. Evidence completeness is distinct from a positive deployment result.

stage_semantics.name: Authorization
stage_semantics.proves: A named authority approved a specified scope/budget/process at a date.
stage_semantics.does_not_prove: An executed obligation, delivery, payment, accepted output or savings.

stage_semantics.name: Executed commitment
stage_semantics.proves: Applicable signed terms identify legal parties, configuration, rights and obligations.
stage_semantics.does_not_prove: Receipts, operation, qualified supply delivery or satisfaction of those obligations.

stage_semantics.name: Payment
stage_semantics.proves: A reconciled amount moved for an identified obligation at a date.
stage_semantics.does_not_prove: Delivery, accepted service, resource efficiency or total economic cost. A prepayment can precede service.

stage_semantics.name: Accepted service
stage_semantics.proves: Unique due work meets declared quality/deadline and disposition requirements, including residual service.
stage_semantics.does_not_prove: Paid staff removed, downstream maintenance value, full program economics or future reliability.

stage_semantics.name: Maintenance or work change
stage_semantics.proves: A linked authorized and, where claimed, completed action or changed paid commitment occurred.
stage_semantics.does_not_prove: Causation, avoided failures, realized cash saving or spare capacity without a feasible counterfactual.

stage_semantics.name: Total payer cost and value
stage_semantics.proves: Matched obligations, resources, payments/liabilities and supported benefits reconcile for each defined actor and horizon.
stage_semantics.does_not_prove: Lifetime/scale/entry return beyond the evidenced horizon, rights, allocation and customer commitments.

cases.label: Hospital logistics
cases.target_status: No current target site/configuration selected; source episodes remain distinct.
cases.minimum_decision: Qualified bounded nonurgent/mixed service; payroll saving requires H5, total cost H6.
cases.recommendation: Prioritize complete due-request and retained-duty evidence before a payroll-funded rollout.

matrix_summary.supported: Specific transport studies and support terms justify bounded nonurgent/mixed-service evaluation, with escort, handling and urgent work retained.
matrix_summary.unresolved: Complete target service, staffing change and full cost.
matrix_summary.minimum: Named route/configuration; applicable site/support commitments; all-request/receipt/intervention and paid-duty cohort. Add actual staffing changes and payer reconciliation only for those claims.
matrix_summary.acceptance: One due-request denominator, clinical/service-owner thresholds and funded fallback. Journey time cannot close payroll or total-cost claims.
matrix_summary.owner: Target pharmacy/logistics, clinical owner, staffing and finance (proposed; site unnamed). Historical study/award parties remain separate.
matrix_summary.decision: Pass permits a bounded service claim; payroll/return waits for H5/H6. Failed mandatory coverage rejects substitution.

cases.label: Utility inspection
cases.target_status: US substation archetype not a named current target; Laredo is a separately identified historical sewer procurement.
cases.minimum_decision: Qualified information service; maintenance value requires U4, paid-work saving U5, complete costs U6.
cases.recommendation: Start with the due measurement/property and residual-duty inventory. Use the Laredo PO trace only to resolve its own procurement stages.

matrix_summary.supported: Operator evidence supports qualified information services; Laredo separately supplies an authorized historical sewer-camera bundle.
matrix_summary.unresolved: Complete target measurements, changed maintenance/paid visit and all-payer cost.
matrix_summary.minimum: Due-asset/property inventory; applicable order/rights; measurement-to-review/residual-duty ledger. For Laredo transaction closure, obtain the PO/amendment and receiving/payment chain for file 25-260.
matrix_summary.acceptance: Same property, asset and window; every residual duty and reviewed disposition accounted for. Laredo records cannot calibrate substation work.
matrix_summary.owner: Target asset/inspection authority, field operations and finance (proposed). Laredo Utilities/RedZone are established parties for that separate procurement.
matrix_summary.decision: Pass can support information value; U4/U5/U6 govern maintenance, paid work and cost. A mandatory visit defeats visit-removal.

cases.label: Automotive presentation
cases.target_status: Historical named source sites and generations exist; no chosen current workcell contract.
cases.minimum_decision: Qualified exact station/sequence; supported changeover/upgrade A4, paid-work effect A5, cost/entry A6.
cases.recommendation: Freeze the common part/handoff and mobility obligation before comparing timing or a newer generation.

matrix_summary.supported: Production-connected component loading and separate fixed/mixed alternatives justify an exact workcell comparison.
matrix_summary.unresolved: Current-generation complete takt/quality, supported flexibility and paid/resource advantage.
matrix_summary.minimum: Actual part/handoff/transport contract; ordered supported configuration; matched part/shift/quality/recovery data, including upstream preparation and paid crew.
matrix_summary.acceptance: Conserve unique parts and actual complete sets; match presentation and transport; validate the exact generation. No synthetic three-part kit or headline vehicle total becomes the observed unit.
matrix_summary.owner: Target plant production/quality, logistics, OEM/integrator and finance (proposed). BMW/Figure/Liebherr identify distinct historical source contexts.
matrix_summary.decision: Pass supports only the qualified station; A4–A6 govern upgrade, staffing and cost. Failed complete service rejects the substitution.

acquisition_batches.output: One target and decision charter per case; use the already defined service units and distinguish historical source episodes.
acquisition_batches.exit: If no target and acceptance owner can be named, stop at archetype guidance. Do not acquire generic performance or price counts.

acquisition_batches.output: One revision-controlled authority and applicable operating/support-entitlement packet per configuration. An evaluation mandate or installed-service entitlement can suffice for a service-only observation; add an executed commercial order only for the commitment/cost claim. Collect invoice/payment records in parallel when applicable.
acquisition_batches.exit: Without authority or qualified/funded continuity, do not validate a target deployment proposal. Missing purchase terms block procurement/return claims, not an otherwise evidenced authorized service result. Public catalogs/awards do not substitute for executed commercial terms.

acquisition_batches.output: One joined due-work, accepted-result, paid-activity, support and fallback dataset per matched baseline/candidate cohort.
acquisition_batches.exit: A complete packet may demonstrate failure. Reject/redesign a nonqualifying substitution before pursuing its claimed savings. An accepted information/capacity service need not show reduced payroll.

acquisition_batches.output: Acquire only records needed for the chosen benefit claim, then reconcile cash/resources on that same cohort and horizon.
acquisition_batches.exit: For unchanged paid commitments, remove payroll savings; for unlinked maintenance, remove avoided-outage/capital benefits. Preserve an explicitly narrower service/cost conclusion rather than treating unknown as zero.

acquisition_batches.output: Only after a bounded case qualifies, test incremental digital/model value or the extra rights, allocation, funding and customer evidence needed for scale/entry.
acquisition_batches.exit: A missing learning, supply or transfer condition blocks that stronger claim; it does not retroactively invalidate a qualified bounded service.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Specific medication/endoscope/Moxi observations exist; urgent exclusion, escort and intervention-count boundaries are material.
requirements.unresolved_claim: Which real hospital, configured route and full obligation is being validated?
minimum_evidence: A dated target charter naming site, route, item classes, exact robot/software/interfaces, all due requests, urgency-specific quality/custody/deadline rules, comparator and responsible acceptance owner.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Owner approves the service definition before examining candidate results; urgent, off-shift, failed and excluded work has an identified service route. The target is not inferred by combining different hospitals or versions.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target pharmacy/logistics and clinical service owner (proposed roles; no target site chosen). The authors/operators identified in FSD-E001–003 are historical-source routes only.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Without this charter, retain an archetype-level wait. If the proposal cannot cover mandatory work with its mixed service, reject that proposal; do not discard requests from the denominator.

requirements.supported_conclusion: A T-2.5 schedule separates site work/support; the Glasgow notice reports a specific maintenance award and installed-system constraint.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The named target has authority and applicable operating terms; if a commercial commitment is claimed, its execution and scope are established. A target operator has authority and applicable installation, support, repair, data and exit rights.
minimum_evidence: For a bounded service-only evaluation: dated owner authorization and applicable access, operating/support entitlement and responsibility for the named configuration. This can be an evaluation mandate or existing installed-service entitlement; no new equipment purchase is required.

Executed order and incorporated revision/attachments, target approval, installed-configuration acceptance plan, named maintenance/fallback obligations, payment milestones and applicable operation/data/transfer terms.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Do not require a purchase order merely to validate an authorized service observation. Close the commercial-commitment claim only with applicable executed terms; the authority-only branch leaves that claim open. Join approval, order, configuration and named legal parties; distinguish approved budget or award notice from an executed applicable agreement. Establish funded fallback and restoration responsibilities. Do not read a minimum correction period as a maximum repair SLA.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target procurement/contract manager and supplier/integrator (proposed). FG-E027 identifies NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde and Aerocom for that separate award; its signed agreement was not retrieved.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Absent applicable rights or funded continuity, wait on operation/scale. A complete agreement can validate commitment, never payment or delivered clinical service.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Studies report selected completions and elapsed transport differences; competent conventional dispatch is an evidenced comparator method.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The proposed mixed service meets the full target obligation better than a feasible digitally improved human alternative.
minimum_evidence: One joined due-request/attempt/receipt ledger for a declared baseline and candidate cohort: urgency, item/route, configuration, attempt/result, custody/quality, timestamps, exclusions, human fallback, interventions and cancellation/disposition. Include workload/staffing conditions and direct activity times.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Every due ID reconciles once to timely accepted, late, failed, cancelled-with-reason or otherwise unserved; attempts never become additional services. Resolve applicable numerator conflicts or exclude the disputed estimate. Compare the same work and access to dispatch information; handle day/shift clustering and case mix. Meet owner-prespecified limits with adequate uncertainty coverage; no universal sample size is inferred.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target dispatch/EHR interface owner, pharmacy/ward receipt owner and evaluation lead (proposed). FSD-E001 raw data are author-request-only; that historical route remains closed here.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: If service fails, reject substitution or redesign eligibility/fallback. If service passes, a bounded capability/capacity claim can advance; no payroll or clinical-outcome saving follows from journey time.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Historical AGVs retained handling, oversight, repair and manual contingency; fee relief does not provide replacement service.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The target can sustain the same service during repair, congestion and competing duties.
minimum_evidence: Join downtime/support tickets and restoration events to the same request ledger, configuration/spares, staff duty calendar, fallback dispatch, receiving duties and actual support resources. Include a documented fallback qualification where no real outage has occurred.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Account for all affected requests and simultaneous duties; verify who was actually available and paid. Separate observed repair outcomes from a contractual promise or a controlled fallback qualification. A window without failures does not establish long-run reliability. Changes to robot maintenance are not improved patient outcomes.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target facilities/biomedical engineering or equivalent service team, supplier support and staffing supervisor (proposed; exact custodians unconfirmed). FSD-E011 describes a contingency but not spare paid capacity.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Unfunded or infeasible fallback blocks a staffing cut and scale claim. A funded, qualified contingency can support bounded service readiness while long-run repair exposure remains open.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Accepted sources distinguish released hours, modeled staffing removal, claimed replacement and actual redeployment.
requirements.unresolved_claim: Robot-enabled change removes a paid commitment or avoids a documented hire/overtime bill.
minimum_evidence: Matched baseline/candidate paid rosters, payroll or contractor invoices, hours/overtime, notice/change records, funded vacancy decisions and receiving-duty ledger; join to the full served demand and intervention work.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Identify the precise commitment that ceased or was not incurred, its effective date, payer and loaded-cost convention. Preserve redeployed staff and other teams’ workload; reconcile demand/case mix and competing changes. A cancelled funded hire is different from a hypothetical headcount requirement. Unchanged pay supports capacity reallocation, not cash saving.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target staffing/HR/payroll, service supervisor and contractor account owner (proposed). Confidential/request-only historical operating data remain inaccessible; no outreach is initiated.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Recognized paid reduction supports only that measured staffing claim. If staff are retained, remove payroll-funded ROI from the case and test paid-for capacity or quality value separately.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Catalog/award prices and economic claims exist, but no target all-payer cash-and-resource account is established.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The qualified service is affordable and offers a defensible customer/provider or entry return.
minimum_evidence: Order-to-invoice-to-payment reconciliation plus same-window site, staff, infrastructure, integration, robot, compute, repair/spares, fallback and provider-resource ledgers; opening assets, unpaid obligations, taxes, financing and horizon/terminal assumptions separately identified.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Each invoice/payment links to legal payer, obligation, date and service scope; unpaid commitments remain liabilities, not paid cost. Reconcile provider receipts with customer transfers and count underlying resources once. Include urgent/residual service. A quoted price, award value or elapsed-time ROI does not fill missing resources. Restrict conclusions to the observed/contracted horizon.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target accounts payable/finance and supplier/integrator accounts (proposed). The public Aethon schedule and Glasgow award identify possible document classes, not target paid accounts.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Proceed with a bounded cost decision only on matched complete service and funded obligations. Without provider resources, report customer cash only; no consolidated cost, provider margin or lifecycle/entry return.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Inspection sources concern different assets/properties; selected instrument coverage and a sewer-camera specification are bounded evidence.
requirements.unresolved_claim: Which due assets and measurements must the target inspection service actually deliver?
minimum_evidence: Owner-approved due-asset/property inventory with route/access conditions, configuration, quality/coverage/deadline, reviewer and mandatory physical duties; qualified human/digital, fixed, mobile and mixed alternatives.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Match property and complete required cohort before comparing prices. Keep substation readings, conductor condition and sewer segments separate. Unsafe direct human entry is not assumed feasible; identify a qualified alternative. Each excluded point has a funded disposition.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target utility asset-management/inspection authority (proposed). TenneT and the named historical operators identify source episodes; Laredo Utilities identifies a distinct sewer-procurement episode.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: If simpler fixed or wheeled sensing meets the same obligation, test it on equal terms. If no alternative covers all duties, retain mixed service; no mobile-platform preference follows from mission count.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Laredo minutes authorize $189,000 and the quote agrees; the background states $189,700. UKPN records distinguish signed contracting and funding-cohort change.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The named target has authority and applicable operating terms; if a commercial commitment is claimed, its execution and scope are established. A chosen utility episode has an executed applicable obligation and a reconciled authorization amount.
minimum_evidence: For a bounded service-only evaluation: dated owner authorization and applicable access, operating/support entitlement and responsibility for the named configuration. This can be an evaluation mandate or existing installed-service entitlement; no new equipment purchase is required.

For the Laredo trace: executed PO/order/amendment tied to file 25-260 and quote OPP-107575, approved scope/amount and price-difference explanation; receiving/configuration and incorporated warranty/license/support terms. For a substation target: its own corresponding documents.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Do not require a purchase order merely to validate an authorized service observation. Close the commercial-commitment claim only with applicable executed terms; the authority-only branch leaves that claim open. Preserve $189,000 as quoted/authorized and the unresolved $700 difference until an attributable record explains it. Verify actual legal payer, rights and order stage; missing PO does not erase council approval. Do not transfer this sewer price or UKPN funding narrative to the substation target.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Laredo Utilities/procurement and RedZone are identified parties; exact PO/receiving custodians and availability are unverified. For a new substation target, procurement/operator and OEM/integrator are proposed roles.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: An executed record closes commitment/rights for its own configuration. Payment and accepted operation remain separate. Without it, do not price an owned supported fleet from an expired quote.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Historical sources show partial coverage, retained review/field work and useful findings; no common current accepted-service ledger exists.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The chosen alternative provides the required timely information and eliminates any claimed residual visit.
minimum_evidence: Joined due-asset/measurement-set ledger: attempts, sensor/configuration/calibration, captured and unreadable/missing points, review timestamp, accepted quality, exceptions, deadline and retained field duty. Record crew, deployment/retrieval, review and support time on the same cohort.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Reconcile original due objects to accepted dispositions and unfinished work; distinguish capture from timely review. Qualify measurement equivalence and residual physical duties. Distance, samples, programmed missions and vendor speed ratios are not accepted sets. Meet target-owned prespecified quality/timeliness limits.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target inspection planners, field operations and reviewing specialists (proposed); relevant operator source authors identify historical contexts only. No access to closed technical papers or authenticated manuals is presumed.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Failed coverage or late review rejects full replacement but may leave a bounded supplementary information service. If mandatory duties still require the visit, reject visit-removal even with more useful measurements.

requirements.supported_conclusion: One public summary links a thermal finding to maintenance; other records describe decision support, wider outages or no replacement requirement.
requirements.unresolved_claim: Accepted information changes an authorized maintenance action and creates attributable value.
minimum_evidence: For each claimed changed action: accepted measurement, reviewer disposition, dated authorized work-order/replacement decision, completion/deferral and cost record; retain the prior plan or feasible counterfactual and other decision inputs.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Join the same asset and decision chain. A justified no-action disposition can be accepted information; it is not automatically an avoided repair. Separate proposed, authorized and completed work. Quantified avoided outage/loss requires a defensible counterfactual, not defect counts or the full outage budget.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target asset owner, maintenance planner, work-order controller and finance (proposed). Historical operator accounts do not establish access to these joined records.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: If a changed decision is established, value only its supported incremental consequence. Without that link, offer a bounded information service and retain maintenance/outage benefit as unknown; do not force a labor-saving rationale.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Prospective person-hour savings, staffed specialist inspection and deployment crews do not establish paid shifts removed.
requirements.unresolved_claim: A complete paid visit, overtime/contract bill or hire changes after the accepted service.
minimum_evidence: Matched required-route and paid-crew/contract ledger including physical checks, traffic/access, deployment/retrieval, review, cleaning, repair and fallback; documented scheduling/notice change and actual payment or funded-hire decision.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Prove that all work attached to the removed visit is completed elsewhere without double-booking or shifting an uncounted bill. Preserve retained commitments. Headcount multiplied by calendar duration and faster data collection cannot substitute for paid-role evidence.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target field-operations supervisor, contractor manager and payroll/accounts payable (proposed); no current role-level records are accepted.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Remove a labor-saving claim if the same paid obligation remains. A valid additional monitoring or capacity service can still be evaluated under its own buyer commitment.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Historical project expenditures, indicative replication costs and a municipal authorization have different boundaries; separately funded site work matters.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The complete inspection option has a defensible all-payer cost and financial advantage.
minimum_evidence: Reconcile executed scope, invoices, payment receipts, receiving/acceptance and recurring support to the same cohort; add installation/site connection, vehicles, staff/review, software/communications, spares, unsuccessful work and financing. Specify opening assets and the qualified comparator.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Authorization/bond allocation is not payment; project expenditure is not a service unit price. Reconcile each payer and shared resources once. Match the truck/robot or fixed/mobile functions and include residual duties; no headline price subtraction. Cost per accepted set requires complete matched obligation, not a reduced successful-only denominator.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target utility project/site finance, procurement/AP, operator and supplier/service provider (proposed). Laredo and National Gas/GRAID are identified historical owners; denied routes stay closed.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Customer cash can be assessed if complete on its own boundary; consolidated/provider economics wait for missing resources. A price interval from synthetic worlds cannot validate this empirical cost.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Figure 02 loading, Figure 03 sequencing/cart movement and a separate fixed vision/buffer cell concern different workflows.
requirements.unresolved_claim: Which actual component set, handoff and changeover obligation must be compared?
minimum_evidence: Target part/BOM and workcell contract: component identities, incoming presentation, required sequence/fixture/cart transport, quality checks, takt/deadline, lot/changeover mix and acceptance owner; human/digital and qualified fixed-cell alternatives.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Freeze the same complete obligation before timing. Keep vehicle contribution, welding and downstream assembly separate. Do not impose the synthetic three-component kit on the real process. Include required mobility or price a separate qualified transport function.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target plant production engineering, logistics and quality owner (proposed). BMW/Figure and the Liebherr-described BMW cell are documented historical parties, not one matched trial.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Stable geometry may favor fixed automation; mobility/flexibility earns consideration only where the actual obligation requires it. An unmatched demonstration cannot choose the embodiment.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Production-connected deployment, integration changes and supplier fleet retirement are reported; target title/support obligations are not disclosed.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The named target has authority and applicable operating terms; if a commercial commitment is claimed, its execution and scope are established. The actual generation, site interfaces and change authority are ordered, available and supported.
minimum_evidence: For a bounded service-only evaluation: dated owner authorization and applicable access, operating/support entitlement and responsibility for the named configuration. This can be an evaluation mandate or existing installed-service entitlement; no new equipment purchase is required.

Plant approval and applicable OEM/integrator order with exact hardware/policy revision, installation interfaces, accepted-delivery milestones, title, repair/spares, upgrade/exit and operation/data rights; named accountable parties.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Do not require a purchase order merely to validate an authorized service observation. Close the commercial-commitment claim only with applicable executed terms; the authority-only branch leaves that claim open. Match contracts to physical serial/configuration and supported dates; verify received/qualified availability separately from announcements. Supplier decommissioning does not establish customer title, remaining life, salvage value or a replacement promise.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target plant procurement/engineering and named OEM/integrator contract owners (proposed). BMW and Figure are established source parties; private terms/custody are unverified.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Absent current support, interfaces or usable rights, wait on deployment/upgrade. A plant approval or owned unit cannot be promoted to supported production capacity.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Historical component/hour totals and a current demonstration motivate qualification; targets are not realized per-shift acceptance.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The configured candidate beats a strong comparator while meeting complete production obligations.
minimum_evidence: PLC/MES or equivalent event ledger joined to part/kit IDs and shift: arrivals, attempts, accepted handoff/quality, deadlines, upstream preparation, buffer/transport state, intervention/fault recovery and staffing; matched human and fixed-vision/presentation alternatives.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Conserve unique components and actual required sets through rework; distinguish load time from full cycle and eventual output from timely acceptance. Use the same information, presentation/redesign authority and required transport. Meet target-owned quality/takt limits across declared part/shift conditions with uncertainty; repeated source totals are not independent replication.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target production/quality/MES owner and integrator (proposed). Source announcements supply no public shift-level joined dataset.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Failed complete service rejects substitution even if individual motions are faster. A qualified bounded station can proceed without broad humanoid, vehicle or workforce claims.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Hardware failures informed redesign; retirement and onsite integration impose work. R&D scores and median compute timing are not supported production.
requirements.unresolved_claim: Changeovers, repair or a new policy/generation improves service enough to justify its disruption and cost.
minimum_evidence: For each claimed change: old/new configuration, failure or changeover tickets, paid engineering/training/installation, qualified parts, downtime and fallback, acceptance/requalification and subsequent matched service; preserve failed attempts and retained-version support.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Join the changed configuration to physical acceptance and ongoing support. Expose costs even if qualification fails; define rollback/old-version entitlement. One new median latency or self-assessment cannot replace a sustained workload/physical test. Claimed flexibility needs representative actual changeovers; otherwise limit the result to the demonstrated part mix.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target maintenance/reliability and production engineering, OEM/model provider and integrator (proposed; exact contracts unverified).
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: A validated change can support a bounded upgrade or flexibility claim; support loss, failed qualification or costly disruption can favor the incumbent configuration. No inherited Figure 02 performance or free transition is allowed.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Feeding, QA, logistics, human assembly and line support remain in the documented workflows; paid reduction is not measured.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The candidate changes paid work after upstream preparation and downstream obligations are counted.
minimum_evidence: Activity/crew assignment and paid shift/contract records joined to the same lot/window; include feeding, material presentation, QA, transport, recovery, maintenance and any redeployed duty; effective staffing/notice and payment changes.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Trace the exact avoidable commitment rather than multiplying loaded parts by a nominal manual cycle. Do not count paid prepared presentation as free robot work or a downstream worker as eliminated. Preserve demand and production mix; isolate other process changes before causal savings claims.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target production/industrial engineering, staffing/payroll and logistics contractor accounts (proposed).
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: If labor stays paid, evaluate reliable output, ergonomics or flexibility only on separately evidenced value. Reject an ROI case funded by unobserved staff cuts.

requirements.supported_conclusion: The sources show configuration and integration boundaries but supply no complete matched lifecycle cash or provider-resource account.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The same production obligation supports a customer purchase or an entrant/provider business case.
minimum_evidence: Executed workcell and comparator orders, invoiced milestones, actual paid dates, engineering/commissioning, barriers/networking, prepared-material cost, maintenance/spares, disruption/fallback, model/compute and financing records; horizon and remaining asset/support rights.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Reconcile legal payers and actual receipts, distinguish capital funding/asset purchase from underlying resource use, and include shared service once. Match flexible production/changeovers if claiming flexibility value. Report observed-window costs where supported; unknown life, support and terminal value block lifecycle ranking.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target plant finance/AP, OEM, integrator and any actual financier (proposed). Named deployments do not establish willingness to share costs.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: A complete matched cash record can rank the defined workcell decision. No target provider margin, universal humanoid economics or greenfield advantage follows without its own costs and customers.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Accepted H/I/K evidence distinguishes conventional dispatch, research scores, self-assessment and component timing from physical service.
requirements.unresolved_claim: An agent/model/learning change adds value beyond the same-technology conventional baseline.
minimum_evidence: Reuse H3/U3/A3 service records and H4/A4 or applicable utility qualification/support records; pin policy/harness/data rights, information access, human approval, failure/retry costs, training/adaptation and sustained runtime resources. Supply a matched no-change/no-learning comparator and a retained-task regression check where transfer is claimed.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Change the claimed mechanism while preserving other comparison privileges, or label confounding. Real accepted service and resource changes must join the versioned intervention; no source-to-target benchmark transfer or second data premium. Acquisition of this evidence is a specification only; no model/GPU/robot run is authorized.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Target service owner plus software/model evaluator, OEM/integrator and resource payer (proposed). Existing benchmark authors are source custodians, not target acceptance authorities.
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Without incremental accepted-service/resource evidence, keep the improved conventional baseline and model contribution unvalidated. Qualification evidence may validate a narrow release; it does not prove fleet scale.

requirements.supported_conclusion: Contract/support dependence, funding transitions and generation changes show why service and financing must remain with their legal parties.
requirements.unresolved_claim: The bounded case scales, or a build/acquire/hybrid entrant retains a funded advantage after incumbent response.
minimum_evidence: Reuse the applicable case cost and service packets; add allocated dated hardware/spares/support capacity, customer service/pricing/renewal commitments, usable data/model/transfer rights, separate legal-entity cash and debt/interest/maturity terms, and funded acquisition/transition/default/fallback obligations.
requirements.evidence_acceptance_criteria: Existing activity transfers once on acquisition; new demand needs evidence. Equal technology access and a competent prompt incumbent remain feasible alternatives. Verify each payer can fund dated work and transitions, including liabilities and retained staff; no aggregate cash substitution. Demonstrated site service or supplier capacity announcements alone do not establish supported allocation or customer retention.
requirements.likely_custodian_or_source: Actual customer/operator, OEM/integrator/support allocator and financier or transaction parties (proposed; no target entrant, financier, acquisition or binding customer book is established).
requirements.custody_status: Proposed functional custodian unless a named party is explicitly identified; possession, availability and access are unverified.
requirements.decision_consequence: Advance only the route supported by applicable executed commitments and a complete funded service. Otherwise wait on entry/scale while retaining a useful site-level result. Do not infer commercial authorization from this research.

keys: due, capture, acceptance, action, invoice and payment timestamps
rules: Keep all due work, failures, exceptions and fallback; freeze units and periods before comparison.
Collect staffing, support and resource time alongside service to avoid unreconstructable retrospective allocation.
Record priced commitments, accruals, actual cash and underlying resources separately; do not sum a fee and the same provider resource cost.
Allocate shared crews/support and facilities once across cases; retain each case unit and demand.
A complete short observation window supports a bounded result only; uncertain tails and lifecycle costs remain explicit.

X1: one of H3/U3/A3 plus applicable qualification/support and cost records
X2: one of H6/U6/A6 with any claimed paid-work or maintenance dependency closed

completed_in_this_tranche: Desk synthesis, ordering and acceptance specification only; no new empirical gap marked closed.
remaining_dependency: One missing joined packet for an explicitly identified historical episode or current target, with an identifiable acceptance owner. Historical parties/episodes can be reused from the accepted records; forward deployment still needs current applicability. Record availability/access is unverified.

scope_modes.historical_claim_audit: Use the exact already identified source episode, configuration, cohort and decision. Do not require selection of a new site; success validates only the historical claim.
scope_modes.forward_deployment: Identify the current site/configuration/authority and qualify transfer, applicable rights and current supported capacity. Historical success does not close these conditions.
